Rina (People Ops): FYI: rolling out updated leave & PTO handbook language + 6 cultural observance days. Draft here: https://intranet.redwood/handbook/leave-draft. Need manager confirmations and training RSVPs this week.
Marta (Eng Manager): Quick check 12 - will this affect our contractors/temps?
Priya (Legal): Contractors not eligible for paid PTO changes; well add a clear section. Local statutory minima remain in force.
Carlos (Payroll): Note payroll cutover needs CSV mapping by 5/15 for June effective date. If training isn't finished we will hold accrual changes for those people.
Oliver (Hiring Ops): For offers: keep existing wording for anyone whose start date is < 2025-06-01; update offers after handbook PR merges. I'll queue templates.
Rina (People Ops): Action list: managers confirm headcount in the sheet, mark RSVP column for training, legal will add contractor language, payroll gets mapping file. I'll send an all-hands blurb once PR merged.
compliance-bot: Reminder scheduled 1h before RSVP deadline.
Marta (Eng Manager): Got it, will update my team and nudge managers.
Priya (Legal): I'll post final appendix with country-specific notes by EOD tomorrow.
Rina (People Ops): Thanks team. Follow-ups tracked in the sheet.
